UPDATE tb_attendance SET -- 퇴근시간 : 지금시간 out_time = SYSDATE,
-- 총 근무시간 total_work_time = ROUND((SYSDATE - in_time) * 24, 2),
-- 연장근무시간(18:00 이후) over_work_time = CASE WHEN SYSDATE > (TRUNC(work_date) + 18/24) THEN ROUND((SYSDATE - (TRUNC(work_date) + 18/24)) * 24, 2) ELSE 0 END,
-- 야간근무(22:00이후) night_work_time = CASE WHEN SYSDATE > (TRUNC(work_date) + 22/24) THEN ROUND( (SYSDATE - (TRUNC(work_date) + 22/24)) * 24, 2 ) ELSE 0 END,
-- 수정자/수정일 updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_date = SYSDATE WHERE company_code = #{companyCode} AND user_id = #{userId} AND work_date = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
